land.feat.sub: Not a chat: an organization with roles, memory, files and rules.

land.how.0.d: Write what you need in plain language. The system proposes a plan, owners and an estimated cost.
land.how.1.d: Agents split the work, produce files and let you know when they need a decision.
land.how.2.d: You check the result, approve sensitive actions and get a report of everything done.
